skipped.reason: Feature request for async cudaHostRegister — no concrete test path referenced; the startup behavior it describes is exercised implicitly by existing simple_kv_offload unit tests.
Roadmap RFC — no concrete test or workload parameters; roadmap items are reflected in individual PRs already captured.
Experimental API (VLLM_ENABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_SESSION_EVICTION=1) with no stable test path yet; the corresponding test file is not present in v0.18.0.

Pluggable eviction policy — the PR body does not reference a new test path beyond test_kv_cache_manager.py which is already in the base harness (unit-kv-cache-manager); annotated with source_ref on that entry.
TOCTOU fix in SimpleCPUOffloadScheduler — the fix is behaviorally covered by gh_simple_kv_offload_scheduler_regression (test_scheduler.py); no separate test path added.
LMCache cache miss — LMCache is an external connector; no test path within the vllm local clone; skip to avoid out-of-tree dependency.
DeepSeek V4 on R6000 GPU — hardware-specific (AMD RDNA3 GPU, not the target hardware for this validation run); skip.

DeepSeek-V4-Flash + OffloadingConnector crashes — requires DeepSeek-V4-Flash model weights which are not available in the local model cache; partially covered by gh_offloading_connector_scheduler_unit.

Skip per-tensor scale parameters from CPU offload — quantization-specific, no distinct test path beyond what is already exercised by quantization/test_cpu_offload.py (not in scope of this validation run's primary target components).
request_finished method + decouple store — internal refactor; covered by existing offloading_connector tests; no new test path needed.
Cache-affinity-aware request ordering RFC — conceptual, no concrete test or workload parameters defined yet.

Version-gated: test path tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/offloading_connector/test_scheduler.py does not exist in v0.18.0. Bug fix for stale sliding-window block offloading (PR by core contributor orozery). Will be relevant when upgrading past v0.18.0.
Version-gated: test path tests/v1/simple_kv_offload/test_scheduler.py does not exist in v0.18.0. Bug fix for flushing final KV block on request finish.
Version-gated: test path tests/v1/core/test_block_pool_double_free.py does not exist in v0.18.0. Bug fix for BlockPool.free_blocks() double-free.
Version-gated: scheduler-side sliding window support tests not in v0.18.0. Relevant to HMA+offloading but test files are post-v0.18.0.
Version-gated: eviction-triggered store feature is new. Test paths tests/v1/kv_offload/cpu/test_manager.py and offloading_connector/test_scheduler.py do not exist in v0.18.0.
Version-gated: test path tests/v1/kv_offload/test_fs_tier.py does not exist in v0.18.0. Page-aligned SharedOffloadRegion is a new feature.
Gemma 4 KVCache CPU offloading broken — model-specific bug requiring Gemma 4 weights not available locally; no distinct test path for this model.
GPU memory leak with Native KV Offloading in multi-node setup (v0.22.0) — version far beyond v0.18.0; multi-node PP=2 TP=8 setup is not reproducible in current test environment.
User question (not a bug report) about initializing KV cache without GPU memory — no test case or workload extractable.
Feature request RFC — disk/SSD support for SimpleCPUOffloadConnector. No concrete test or implementation yet.
Multi-tier KV offloading RFC — conceptual design discussion; no concrete test paths or workload parameters.

CUDA crash with KV Offloading + EAGLE3 + Expert Parallel on 8×H20 — requires specific hardware (8×H20 141GB) and EAGLE3 speculative decoding model not available. Regression signal captured in source_refs on gh_basic_cpu_offload_correctness.

notes: Second discovery pass (2026-06-01). GitHub REST API used (gh CLI not available in this environment). Queries expanded with additional terms: 'kv_connector offload', 'SimpleCPUOffload', 'OffloadingConnector', 'swap_blocks kv', 'cpu_kv_cache OR kv_cache_dtype offload'. All new test paths strictly verified against the v0.18.0 tag via `git ls-tree -r --name-only v0.18.0 <path>`. Many promising findings (stale SWA blocks #42959, BlockPool double-free #42612, final block flush #41777, eviction-triggered store #43946, FS-tier page alignment #43689) were version-gated out because their test paths were added after v0.18.0. These are noted in the skipped list with 'Version-gated:' prefix for future reference when upgrading. The base artifacts/kvoffload/ files were not modified. Maintainer engagement verified via comments endpoint for all issues used as primary sources (#31210, #35507, #41515, #40259).
